title: encrypt.rs build_kari_recipient: ephemeral_pub_bytes: Vec<u8> should be &[u8]
description: build_kari_recipient() takes ephemeral_pub_bytes: Vec<u8> but only reads from it. Owned Vec<u8> parameter forces callers to either pass ownership or clone. The parameter could be &[u8] — BitString::from_bytes() takes &[u8]. Owned parameters force callers to allocate or clone at every call site. Both callers pass .to_sec1_point(false).as_bytes().to_vec() which allocates unnecessarily.
